### Specialist Prestige Buyer's Agencies

- **PMC Property Buyers** : A specialized buyer-side advisory firm focusing on high-net-worth, corporate, and international buyers. They operate entirely on behalf of the purchaser to source confidential, unlisted prestige homes and riverfront properties across Southeast Queensland with strict anonymity.[[1]](https://www.pmcproperty.com.au/prestige-property-buyers/)
- **Prestige Property Buyer / Glen Sainsbury** : Acts as a dedicated local buyer's advocate focusing on high-value acquisitions in blue-chip inner-suburbs like Ascot, Hamilton, and New Farm, specializing in securing off-market heritage and luxury modern assets.[[1]](https://prestigepropertybuyer.com.au/brisbane)
